name: Claude waker
description: Sends a tiny "Hello" to the Claude CLI when you log in or your PC wakes from sleep, so your 5-hour usage window starts as early as possible. Or wake it with one click.
author: AmineChr54

commands.description: Sends "Hello" to Claude to start the usage window

view.label: View
view.hint: Usage clock shows the time left in the 5-hour window as a ring.

onLogon.label: Wake when Umbra starts
onLogon.hint: Once per Umbra start (log in), if the minimum gap has passed.

onResume.label: Wake after sleep
onResume.hint: Detects when the PC resumed from sleep. One wake per resume.

minGapHours.label: Minimum gap (hours)
minGapHours.hint: Never wake more often than this. 5 matches the usage window.

quietEnabled.label: Quiet hours
quietEnabled.hint: No automatic wakes between the two hours below. Wake now still works.
